qa_stack.profile: bring the stack up with `docker compose -f compose.yml up -d --wait` and drive it over http://localhost:18083; sandboxed runs reach the same URL through the forwarded port declared in qa-stack.yml
fixtures: none — a fresh ledger is an empty showing, which is exactly this story's subject
qa_stack.capable_of_rendering: the seat map page on `/` and the JSON map on `/api/seats`, both against the live ledger
qa_stack.notes: there is no unit-test surface to lean on: the container has the service and nothing else, so every claim has to come from an HTTP response or the rendered page
